Full Category VII Trajectory & Lineage Topology Evaluation (dynverse Workflow)

Source: R/06_metrics_trajectory.R
evaluate_trajectory_metrics.Rd

Evaluates trajectory and lineage preservation using the standardized dynverse benchmarking framework (Saelens et al., Nature Biotechnology, 2019):

  1. Standardized cell outlier QC (3 MADs), low-expression gene filtering (\(\ge 5\%\) cells, mean \(> 0.02\)), and HVG selection (scran::modelGeneVar).

  2. Shared HVG PCA projection and Docker-free Minimum Spanning Tree (MST) milestone trajectory inference with continuous cell-to-milestone geodesic distances.

  3. Five complementary trajectory metrics: him (Hamming-Ipsen-Mikhailov similarity), edge_flip (minimum edge flip similarity), geodesic_correlation, F1_branches, and wcor_features (ranger Random Forest feature importance weighted correlation with num_trees = 10000 and 1 percent mtry).

Usage

evaluate_trajectory_metrics(
  ref_data,
  sim_data,
  cell_types_ref = NULL,
  cell_types_sim = NULL,
  num_trees = 10000L,
  nmads = 3,
  min_cell_frac = 0.05,
  min_mean_expr = 0.02,
  fdr_threshold = 0.05,
  bio_var_threshold = 0.5,
  threads = 1L,
  seed = 42L,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

ref_data

Reference count matrix, SingleCellExperiment, or Seurat object.

sim_data

Simulated count matrix, SingleCellExperiment, or Seurat object.

cell_types_ref

Optional vector of reference cell types.

cell_types_sim

Optional vector of simulated cell types.

num_trees

Number of ranger trees per milestone for wcor_features (default 10000L).

nmads

MAD cutoff for outlier cell QC (default 3).

min_cell_frac

Minimum cell fraction per gene (default 0.05).

min_mean_expr

Minimum average gene count (default 0.02).

fdr_threshold

FDR threshold for HVG selection (default 0.05).

bio_var_threshold

Biological variance threshold for HVG selection (default 0.5).

threads

Number of CPU threads for ranger (default 1L).

seed

Random seed (default 42L).

verbose

Logical; print progress messages.

Value

A named list of Category VII dynverse trajectory accuracy metrics:

him

Hamming-Ipsen-Mikhailov topology similarity ([0, 1]).

edge_flip

Edge flip topology similarity ([0, 1]).

geodesic_correlation

Spearman correlation of aligned geodesic distances ([0, 1]).

F1_branches

Macro F1 overlap of MST branch assignments ([0, 1]).

wcor_features

Reference-weighted Pearson correlation of Random Forest gene importances ([0, 1]).

cor_features

Unweighted Pearson correlation of Random Forest gene importances.

n_hvgs

Number of HVGs retained for trajectory evaluation.

ref_trajectory

Inferred reference milestone trajectory object.

sim_trajectory

Inferred simulated milestone trajectory object.

preprocessing_summary

Cell and HVG filtering summary list.

Examples

data(example_scrna, package = "scSimEval")
evaluate_trajectory_metrics(
  example_scrna$ref, example_scrna$sim,
  cell_types_ref = example_scrna$cell_types,
  cell_types_sim = example_scrna$cell_types,
  num_trees = 500L
)
